description: This file defines a 'Navigator' class responsible for handling navigation state management within an Android application. It includes functions for navigating to specific keys, going back, and managing navigation stacks.

classes.name: Navigator
classes.description: Handles navigation events by updating the NavigationState; supports navigating forward, back, to specific keys, and managing navigation stacks.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates to a specified NavKey, either clearing sub-stack or navigating to top level or a specific key.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Handles the back navigation, either removing last from sub-stack or top-level stack, or erroring when at start.

methods.name: goToKey
methods.description: Navigates to a non top level key by updating the current sub-stack.

methods.name: goToTopLevel
methods.description: Navigates to a top-level key, updating the top level stack accordingly.

methods.name: clearSubStack
methods.description: Clears the current sub-stack except for the root key.
